about: OA Surf Club is based at Atlantic Court in Widemouth Bay, near Bude, and combines accommodation with surf lessons, coasteering and surf hire. It also hosts school trips, yoga retreats and qualification courses. Its beginner and improver surf lessons run daily for individuals, groups and schools, and its hire trailer sits in the Widemouth Bay car park.
offers: Beginner and improver surf lessons (2 hours)
Surfboard and wetsuit hire for 2 hours, half a day or a full day
where: Atlantic Court, Widemouth Bay; hire trailer in the Widemouth Bay car park
goodToKnow: Surf lessons include a wetsuit and board
Coasteering includes a wetsuit, buoyancy aid and helmet
Book online or by enquiry form; activity and accommodation terms are on the website
gaps: No season, age limits, what to bring, cancellation terms or named accreditations
